Re: Appeal of Prior Authorization Denial  
Member: Avery Alvarez  
Member ID: W460125797  
Reference number: POC-55381BDBC3-44861  
Requested service: Total ankle replacement  
CPT code: 27702  
Ordering surgeon: Reyes, MD, Orthopedic Surgery

Dear Appeals Reviewer:

I am appealing the denial dated August 20, 2026, for the requested total ankle replacement. The denial states that the documentation was incomplete and did not permit a determination of medical necessity.

Please reconsider the request based on the clinical documentation submitted with the prior authorization packet and the following summary of my condition and treatment history:

- I have had 12 months of progressive ankle pain that has not improved with rest.
- I completed 16 supervised physical-therapy visits over 10 weeks, from May 15, 2026, through July 24, 2026. Therapy focused on ankle strengthening and balance, and the physical-therapy discharge note documents this course.
- I used NSAIDs for six months with inadequate relief.
- A corticosteroid injection on April 29, 2026, produced only three weeks of partial relief.
- Weight-bearing ankle radiographs dated July 12, 2026, show obliteration of the tibiotalar joint space with subchondral cysts.
- My functional capacity is substantially impaired: I walk with an antalgic gait and am limited to approximately two blocks.
- Examination shows positive provocative testing on the affected side and range of motion limited by pain.
- There is no active infection, no untreated substance use, BMI is 29, and I am a nonsmoker.

These records address the duration and severity of symptoms, objective imaging findings, functional limitation, examination findings, and unsuccessful conservative treatment. They also document the limited and temporary response to injection therapy and the absence of the relevant medical risk factors identified in the clinical summary.

The requested procedure is total ankle replacement under CPT 27702. I ask UnitedHealthcare to conduct a complete medical-necessity review using the enclosed records and to authorize the procedure.

The public UnitedHealthcare policy identified as Surgery of the Ankle applies to CPT 27702. I have not quoted the plan’s policy because the policy text could not be retrieved in an accessible form. If UnitedHealthcare relied on additional clinical criteria, including proprietary criteria, please provide the specific criteria applied to this request, identify each item of documentation considered missing, and explain how the records listed above fail to satisfy those criteria.

If any information remains necessary, please identify it precisely and allow the treating surgeon an opportunity to submit it. Please also provide a peer-to-peer review with Reyes, MD, if available.

This appeal is submitted before the February 16, 2027 deadline stated in the denial notice. Please send the appeal determination and any request for additional information to:

Avery Alvarez  
[Mailing address]  
[Telephone number]  
[Email address]

Sincerely,

Avery Alvarez  
[Signature, if submitted by mail]
